title: Research Brief
description: DISCOVER-stage artifact (absorption wave 1; open_deep_research recipe). Output of the deep_research operate mode: the supervisor decomposes the topic into perspective-split research angles (STORM-style principled split), each researcher's findings are compressed per-researcher before merging, and the brief records iterations used against the budget counters (max_iterations_without_new_evidence / max_fulltext_reads — the previously-dead budget knobs this mode wires live). Findings carry source_refs by reference only.
